lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.title: Загрузка слоя показывает только понятный собственный текст
value.surface: LayerFill progress KEY_MESSAGE and Toast error consumer
value.meaning: Layer import presents only owned localized error copy. Positive typed NGW HTTP server failures use the shared server explanation. Unknown IO/SQLite/JSON/raw NGException detail stays in diagnostics and receives a human retry message; a missing JSON fields member does not prove denied access.
value.value_origin: Explicit initial metadata HTTP failure -> NgwHttpResponseException (existing NGException catch/message policy); transient initial feature HTTP failure -> NgwHttpException (existing IOException catch/retry policy); both contain only status/safe server boolean. These typed origins or an owned NGException resource -> LayerFillErrorMessage.forException -> LayerFillService setError/notifyError -> progress KEY_MESSAGE/Handler Toast. POINTZ retains its original dedicated dialog/early-return branch.
value.units: Human-readable localized text; no coordinates, CRS, server-body units or technical status dump.
updates: Existing operation lifecycle decides when a dialog/notification/progress message is delivered. A displayed explanation is separate from remote ACK, durable save or full-project completion.
actions: Read the cause and suggested next action; retry through the existing operation only after the reported condition changes.
conditions: Owned-resource equality is a display allowlist, never inference of HTTP status from arbitrary exception text.
Only bounded numeric placeholders in the owned count-mismatch template are accepted; unsupported text falls back to fixed resource copy.
Initial HTTP origins and retry stages remain explicitly bounded by Core source review; no arbitrary body parsing or whole-service availability inference.
External-database body text can classify only HTTP422;408 remains generic/connect-timeout, while429/all5xx remain server. Same HTTP retry classification is preserved.
value.saved_state: No new persistent error journal, automatic resend, saved-state migration or server mutation is introduced. Existing local edits/recovery and cancellation ownership remain separate contracts.
expectations: HTTP503 technical URL/password/path and SQLite/JSON exception details must not appear in user text.
Preserve own offline/rights/CRS/geometry/coordinate messages and POINTZ behavior; malformed fields JSON stays generic rather than permission403.
unknowns: Technical formatter cases are not real Service/Handler/Toast/progress-window acceptance. Other untyped cookie/capability/connect/TUS/HTTP200/malformed-response origins remain generic or UNKNOWN; the two explicitly typed initial metadata/feature branches are source-covered, not real-server accepted.
